steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable the required vendor-lock configuration before opening the create screen.
Enable the required read-only price-cap configuration.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title required on create screens.
Choose the available RFQ pricing template.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Assert that Publish Event is greyed out.
Hover the disabled control to reveal its explanatory tooltip.

args.text: Please choose a template and add a product

steps.note: Verify the tooltip contains the expected reason.
Confirm clicking the greyed-out Publish Event opens nothing and causes no change.
